label: VAT Return Data Validator
description: Validates VAT return data before submission. Checks input/output VAT consistency, identifies suspicious patterns, ensures correct application of reduced rates and exemptions, and prepares audit trail.

claudeKnowledge.description: Swedish Mervärdesskattelagen, EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC, Skatteverket VAT reporting requirements, EC Sales List rules

guidedInputs.label: VAT return data
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste your VAT return figures or ledger summary. Include:
- Output VAT by rate (25%, 12%, 6%)
- Input VAT by rate
- Exempt supplies
- EU acquisitions / reverse charge
- Export amounts
- Prior period adjustments

e.g.
Box 05: Taxable sales 25% — 2 450 000 SEK
Box 10: Output VAT 25% — 612 500 SEK
Box 20: Taxable acquisitions from EU — 340 000 SEK
Box 30: Input VAT deductible — 187 500 SEK
...

guidedInputs.label: General ledger VAT account summary (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Paste GL account balances for VAT accounts to cross-check against the return figures.

guidedInputs.label: Known issues or unusual transactions
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe any transactions or adjustments that may require special VAT treatment this period.
